title: Editorial checks function reads Amplify secret placeholders instead of keys
description: The editorial-checks Lambda is Python: Amplify passes secret() values as a '<value will be resolved during runtime>' placeholder plus AMPLIFY_SSM_ENV_CONFIG, and only Node functions resolve them automatically. papyrus_content.editorial_checks passed the placeholder to Limatus (Jev and OpenAI auth would fail) and the function role had no ssm:GetParameter grant. Fix: resolve the provider keys from SSM at cold start (unset when unavailable so the lanes report 'unavailable'), and grant read on the app's Amplify secret paths.
